text:
karim: Quick heads-up — PR #4521 is blocked from merging. Windows smoke job failed on Windows-latest e2e (flaky-looking). Can someone take a quick look?

sara: pinging @leo and @maya — do we want to hold the merge window until this is green?

ci-bot: [build 4521 · windows-e2e] FAILED — https://ci.internal/reports/4521/windows-e2e (exit code 1) 

ci-bot: Failed test: test_suite::integration::smoke_startup (stdout excerpt below)
```
[2026-03-17T09:12:31Z] ERROR: timeout waiting for service ready (120s)
Trace: wait_for_socket: connection refused
```

leo: Looks like the container didn't come up in time — we've seen this intermittently on windows-agent-4. Might be infra noise, not the PR. Can we rerun just the windows-e2e job?

maya: I can kick a targeted rerun now. /rerun job windows-e2e for 4521? (if allowed) :robot_face:

karim: yes please. Also note the PR touches startup order for the mock-backend so low risk. If rerun is green we can merge in the next 30m window.

ci-bot: Rerun request accepted. Enqueued job 4521-rr1.

ci-bot: [build 4521-rr1 · windows-e2e] PASSED

maya: rerun passed, but there's a snapshot mismatch in `integration-ui/snapshot_login.png` on mac/linux jobs — looks unrelated to the startup flake. Screenshot diff: small whitespace change in header.

sara: hmm, screenshot diffs are in another job — do we update snapshot or revert the UI tweak in this PR? The UI change was incidental to a refactor in the test harness.

leo: Can you paste the small diff? If it's just pixel shift from font rendering I'd prefer to update the snapshot after confirming tests are deterministic. If tests are flaky on CI Runners we should avoid approving snapshot update blindly.

maya: diff link: https://ci.internal/artifacts/4521/snapshots/diff-01.png — it's literally a 2px vertical shift in the header. Code change touched CSS resets in test harness.

karim: my change did touch the harness CSS. The refactor intentionally tightened margins. I think updating the snapshot is the right call, but we should add a note in the PR description and an entry in the test-changes.md.

sara: agreed. @leo can you give a quick review + approve once I add the snapshot update commit? Would prefer one more approval before merge.

leo: I'll review in ~10m. If snapshot update is a single file and CI is green (windows and linux), happy to approve.

maya: I'll queue another full CI run after the snapshot commit. Please include the updated snapshot file under `tests/__snapshots__/integration-ui/snapshot_login.png`.

karim: adding snapshot update now. committing `update: integration-ui login snapshot (ci-approved)`

ci-bot: New commit pushed to PR #4521: sha abc1234 — running pipeline.

ci-bot: [build 4521-rr2 · full] windows-e2e: PASSED, linux-e2e: PASSED, mac-e2e: PASSED, snapshots-check: PASSED

leo: reviewed and left a small comment on the test doc. Approving now. :white_check_mark:

sara: thanks team — merge window still open for 30m, I'll merge once the branch is green and approvals are present.

karim: thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. Filing a short post-note in #eng-postmortems for the intermittent windows-agent-4 delay so infra can triage.

maya: noted. Adding a TODO to monitor windows-agent-4 failure rate this week. :mag:
